title: Mod Menu MITE
description: Adds a mod menu to view the list of MITE mods you have installed.
body:
# Mod Menu MITE
You can find the 'Mods' button in the game's Settings menu.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DwTVZoUu/images/5fe00d6066f5f497a8c344d16a091dcf2f910bde.png)
The ModMenu allows you to view installed mods and, if supported, provides quick and convenient access to their configuration screens.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DwTVZoUu/images/d2808efb2daa4c848df4610112d1b0a21703fcfe.png)
